title: The ThreatLabz data source and the Finding Is Mitigated field: which Zscaler services mitigate which CVEs

tl-what.statement: The ThreatLabz data source retrieves the data ThreatLabz maintains on how CVEs are mitigated by Zscaler services (including Internet & SaaS and Private Access), and is provisioned in every new account.

quotes: the ThreatLabz team maintains a database of CVEs with information on how they're mitigated by different Zscaler services.
The ThreatLabz data source is provisioned in every new account created within the Agentic Security Operations Platform
which CVEs are mitigated by which Zscaler services, including Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and Private Access (ZPA)

tl-risk-scores.statement: ThreatLabz data is correlated with deduplicated asset records and Zscaler service coverage to calculate contextualized risk scores based on the protection the Zscaler services provide.

quotes: which is then correlated with your deduplicated asset records and Zscaler service coverage.
This information is used to calculate contextualized risk scores based on the level of protection provided by your Zscaler services.

tl-zcc-crossref.statement: Cross-referencing ThreatLabz data with the Zscaler Client Connector Devices data source, which reports which Zscaler services are installed on which assets, shows which Zscaler services protect against specific CVEs, as a mitigating factor for finding scoring.

quotes: The Zscaler Client Connector Devices data source retrieves data on assets in your organization, including which Zscaler services are installed on which assets.
By cross-referencing ThreatLabz data with Zscaler Client Connector data, you can determine which of your Zscaler services are protecting against specific CVEs in your security environment.
This insight can be used as a mitigating risk factor to inform finding scoring.

tl-is-mitigated.statement: The Finding Is Mitigated field is TRUE when a service that can mitigate the CVE (per ThreatLabz) is installed on the asset where it was detected (per Zscaler Client Connector Devices) and FALSE otherwise, set by a unification rule.

quotes: returning TRUE when a match is found (i.e., when a CVE found on your asset is mitigated by a Zscaler service installed on it) or FALSE otherwise.

The unification rule checks if any of the services that can mitigate the vulnerability (as reported by the ThreatLabz data source) are actually installed on the asset where the vulnerability was detected
(as reported by the Zscaler Client Connector Devices data source)

tl-score-factor.statement: The Finding Is Mitigated field feeds the CVE Mitigated By factor in UVM finding score settings, which can be adjusted.

quotes: The Finding Is Mitigated field is used in the score settings for Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) findings to create the CVE Mitigated By factor
You can adjust this setting to align with your organization's specific requirements.

tl-zia-label.statement: In the platform the Internet & SaaS service is displayed as ZIA, as in the Vulnerability Mitigation Products and Asset Mitigation Products field values.

quotes: The Internet & SaaS service is displayed as ZIA in the Agentic SecOps Platform.
the value of the Vulnerability Mitigation Products field is ZIA
the Asset Mitigation Products field value is ZIA
